panel.heading: Baƙi masu sanyi ko masu saurare?
left: Baƙi a wurin isar da ku
right: Kasance tare da ku a cikin kwanaki 60

say: Tallace-tallacen da ta ɗorawa ta mayar da hankali ga mutanen da suka yi hulɗa da Instagram a cikin kwanaki 60 da suka gabata, tare da farashi da maɓallin WhatsApp. Ya kawo chatting guda 42 akan naira 250 kowanne, da karin oda.
Kada ku kai hari ga duk Najeriya idan kuna bayarwa a birni ɗaya kawai.

card.title: Shin tallan Rukayat yana biya?
card.note: Ƙididdiga na Naira suna kwatantawa kuma kusan.

say: Ana sayar da kowane fakitin kimanin naira 6,500. Bayan an gama hada kayan ne, ta shirya da kuma kawowa ta ajiye kimanin naira 2,500. Wato karya-koda kudinta na kowane oda. Dole ne tallan tallace-tallace su yi ƙasa da wannan.

card.title: Shin tallan Rukayat yana biya?
card.note: Ƙididdiga na Naira suna kwatantawa kuma kusan.

say: Tana kashe kimanin naira 2,000 a rana tsawon kwanaki 7, naira 14,000 gaba daya. Tallan yana kawo tattaunawa 40, don haka naira 350 kowanne. Daga waɗancan hirarraki tana samun umarni 10, adadin juzu'i na kashi 25 cikin ɗari.

card.title: Shin tallan Rukayat yana biya?
card.note: Ƙididdiga na Naira suna kwatantawa kuma kusan.

say: Kudin kowane oda 14,000 ne aka raba kashi 10, wato naira 1,400. Wannan bai kai 2,500 ba, don haka kowane oda har yanzu yana barin ribar kusan naira 1,100 bayan talla. Tallan yana biya.

Kuma bi dokokin talla. Kada ka taɓa yin da'awar samfur yana warkar da cuta, kuma kar a taɓa amfani da rangwamen karya ko hotunan wani.
